defect.proposed_fix: Keep Status: good as of 2026-06-30, but replace 'No negative treatment' with a narrower statement such as: 'Lake status is good_law as of 2026-06-30; no final point override or downgrade is recorded, though treatment derivation contains proposed negative-treatment edges requiring audit.'

residual_risks: A completed treatment audit could alter the good-law status or identify point-specific limits; external checking was not performed under the ground rules.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Qualify the treatment prose to distinguish final lake status from proposed/audit-needed negative-treatment signals.
